name: axis-twelve
description: Build faster, center easier. Modular CSS framework with grid, flexbox, centering, buttons, forms, modals, tables, cards, and tooltips.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:full && pnpm run build:modules && pnpm run build:legacy
scripts.build:full: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-twelve.scss dist/axis-twelve.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-twelve.scss dist/axis-twelve.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:modules: pnpm run build:layout && pnpm run build:buttons && pnpm run build:forms && pnpm run build:modals && pnpm run build:tooltips && pnpm run build:tables && pnpm run build:cards
scripts.build:layout: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-layout.scss dist/modules/axis-layout.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-layout.scss dist/modules/axis-layout.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:buttons: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-buttons.scss dist/modules/axis-buttons.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-buttons.scss dist/modules/axis-buttons.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:forms: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-forms.scss dist/modules/axis-forms.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-forms.scss dist/modules/axis-forms.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:modals: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-modals.scss dist/modules/axis-modals.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-modals.scss dist/modules/axis-modals.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:tooltips: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-tooltips.scss dist/modules/axis-tooltips.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-tooltips.scss dist/modules/axis-tooltips.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:tables: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-tables.scss dist/modules/axis-tables.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-tables.scss dist/modules/axis-tables.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:cards: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-cards.scss dist/modules/axis-cards.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-cards.scss dist/modules/axis-cards.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:legacy: pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-twelve-legacy.scss dist/axis-twelve-legacy.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && pnpm exec sass src/builds/axis-twelve-legacy.scss dist/axis-twelve-legacy.min.css --style=compressed
